title: SREV-050 DNS filter WSAQUERYSETW response buffer contract

lpdwBufferLength.description: Caller-provided buffer byte capacity on input and required capacity on WSAEFAULT

packed_layout.description: WSAQUERYSETW-owned strings, CSADDR_INFO entries, socket addresses, BLOB, HOSTENT, and relative HOSTENT payloads

contracts: WSALookupServiceNextW receives lpqsResults as a caller-provided output buffer
lpdwBufferLength is the byte capacity on input and required size on WSAEFAULT
WSA_FillResponseStructure owns the packed WSAQUERYSETW response layout
Every write advance in the packed response must be gated against bufferEnd in release builds
The final sanity check is diagnostic only and cannot be the first release-mode overflow gate
HOSTENT pointer-typed fields store relative offsets from the HOSTENT base
